name: Dynamic Luminance Information (DLI) Smoke Animation
definition: A method to create the illusion of volumetric smoke animation by compositing a Dynamic Luminance Information (DLI) layer onto a static Computer Graphics (CG) base image, avoiding the computational cost of frame-by-frame volume rendering.
summary: Dynamic Luminance Information Smoke Animation creates volumetric smoke illusions by compositing time-varying 2D luminance layers onto static CG images, offering a computationally efficient alternative to frame-by-frame volume rendering.
